justifications.text: Reads the mission you pick, load and play in Warframe (node, planet, type, faction, its variants, result, duration, the rotations earned and the credits), to show its loot and a one-line recap at the end.
Reads the rewards given and their cycle, the wave and its enemies, and when the next reward comes, to count down to the next rotation and show the rotations earned.
Reads what the mission's node can give, by rotation, with each item's chance, from Digital Extremes' drop tables as PlayerVox OverCrow gives them. The widget makes no request of its own.
Keeps the last mission's recap (node, type, result, duration, rotations earned, credits) on this computer, to show it after the game.
